editorial.blurb: The Port is a welcoming tavern-style gathering place where homemade food, attentive service, and a convivial atmosphere make it the kind of spot you'll want to return to again and again.
editorial.insiderTip: Visit on all-you-can-eat catfish nugget night, and don't hesitate to ask for Heidi or Hallie by name—the staff genuinely cares about getting your order right and making your experience special.
